items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: He always, he was crazy about me though, as far as, our paths were always, they crossed pleasantly... Steel was a very big six-footer and tough as a boot. He used to come around and say, look boy, if they give you any trouble, just tell me.

ctx.x: They were cut at extreme angles. Uh-huh. They had, uh, everything jazzy that you can think of and corny. It, uh, it was put into a suit and called a jazz model suit. They were advertised as jazz model suits. Uh-huh. And, uh, sold as such. I remember Blue Steel, who was a very famous orchestra leader. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. I saw him wearing one one time in, uh, in Shreveport, where I was located at the time. Some of the musicians wore these jazz model suits, but I can tell you that the Blue Melody Boys never…
